Meet Vinnie's on 11

Family Italian restaurant and pizzeria

Vinnie's on 11 is a family-run Italian restaurant and pizzeria located on Molly Pitcher Highway in Chambersburg, PA. The restaurant offers a variety of dishes including pizza, stromboli, and daily lunch specials.

The menu includes daily lunch specials available from 10:30 AM to 2:00 PM, wraps, subs, stromboli, and pasta. The cheesesteak on a fresh-baked roll, white pizza, and spaghetti and meatballs are all on the menu.

Vinnie's also features a covered outdoor patio seating for diners to enjoy their meals al fresco. The restaurant accepts credit cards and offers takeout and delivery services.

Dine-in

No reservations required. Order at the counter, food brought to the table.
